💤 Sleep Summary

Bed 23:45 → wake 07:57 · 8h 12m in bed · 7h 57m asleep · 15 min awake Sleep score 84 (age-adjusted 88), well above your median of 82.5 — a clean night. You said you felt OK this morning.

Your check-in note: You flagged that the windows were open overnight rather than only during the pre-cool. That's consistent with what the sensors show — the room was already cool at sleep onset and stayed cool all night, so this is recorded context rather than a problem.

📊 Metrics vs Baselines

Age-adjusted sleep score: 88 — 5.5 points above your median of 82.5, nudging above your upper quartile of 87. A genuinely good night on your own distribution.

Readiness: 64 (Moderate) — above your personal median of 60 and your absolute floor of 60, and trending the right way.

HRV: 47 ms overnight / 47 ms 7-day average — dead on your 7-day baseline median of 47 ms, squarely in your normal band (44–56 ms), and Garmin calls it Balanced. No suppression.

Resting HR: 44 bpm — at your long-run median of 44, well below the 50–59 age average of 71. No elevation.
